@graph.description: Three-month workforce hiring plan template covering define-and-prepare, source-and-evaluate, and convert-and-review phases with a shared hiring tracker.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a three-month framework that ties approved headcount to sourcing, interview milestones and joining targets. The EarlyJobs template helps Indian HR teams phase work instead of treating hiring as a continuous emergency.
HR usually owns the document, with input from department heads, finance and hiring managers. Plant or branch leaders add location-specific volumes and shift coverage before week one.
Yes. Map multiple vacancies and sites across the same 90-day calendar, with owners per phase. Pair the plan with the Bulk Hiring Checklist when volumes spike in a single month.

mainEntity.name: Does the plan guarantee hiring targets?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is a planning tool only. Outcomes depend on candidate supply, employer selection speed, compensation decisions and operational readiness—not on the template itself.

@graph.name: How to build a 90-day workforce hiring plan
@graph.description: Three-month hiring framework connecting workforce requirements with recruitment activities, responsible teams and expected milestones.

step.name: Define and Prepare (Days 1–30)
step.text: Collect vacancy requests, approve budgets, prepare job descriptions and establish recruitment responsibilities.

step.name: Source and Evaluate (Days 31–60)
step.text: Activate sourcing channels, coordinate interviews, conduct assessments and review recruitment progress.

step.name: Convert and Review (Days 61–90)
step.text: Confirm offers, coordinate joining dates, review open vacancies and evaluate hiring performance.
